meta.description: Run a user story mapping workshop with adaptive questions and a structured map output. Use when you need backbone activities, tasks, and release slices for a workflow.

copy.tagline: 引导用户故事映射工作坊，产出结构化地图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将用户流程拆解为可交付的版本切片
copy.tagline_en: Run a user story mapping workshop with structured output
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break down user workflows into deliverable slices

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成用户故事地图的创建：先问几个关于系统、用户和工作流程的问题，然后生成一张二维地图，包含主干活动、用户任务和发布切片。
howto.when: 当你需要为一个工作流程规划主干活动、任务和发布切片时，可以要求 Claude 运行用户故事地图工作坊。

say.text: 帮我为供应商入驻门户运行一个故事地图工作坊。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问，逐步生成地图。

say.text: 为电商结账流程创建一个用户故事地图。
say.note: Claude 会询问范围、用户等，然后输出地图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through creating a user story map: it asks adaptive questions about the system, users, and workflow, then generates a two-dimensional map with backbone activities, user tasks, and release slices.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need backbone activities, tasks, and release slices for a workflow. Ask Claude to run a user story mapping workshop.

say_en.text: Run a story mapping workshop for our vendor onboarding portal.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions and generate the map.

say_en.text: Create a user story map for an e-commerce checkout flow.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about scope, users, etc., then output the map.
